correctness.rationale: An admissible face in CF3 of a graph join may meet at most two factors; a face meeting two factors must be an independent set in each. Thus CF3 is the union of P=union_{i<j}(A_i*A_j) and disjoint full factor simplices Delta_i, with P intersect Delta_i=A_i. The inclusion A_i into every adjacent A_i*A_j is nullhomotopic via a vertex in the opposite factor. In the cofibrant incidence graph-of-spaces diagram there are no higher composable morphisms, so the homotopy colimit splits using constant incidence maps. Its incidence graph first Betti number is binom(r-1,2); each singleton contributes r-2 unreduced suspensions, and all pairwise join vertex spaces remain. Attaching each contractible Delta_i along its nullhomotopic A_i inclusion contributes one further suspension. This derives the integral wedge of binom(r-1,2) circles, (r-1) suspensions per factor and all A_i*A_j. Works for disconnected independence complexes, r=2 and trivial factors. New full GF(2) simplicial enumerations for cycle combinations (4,4), (5,5), (4,4,4), (5,5,5) matched the predicted degrees; the all-graph statement follows from the homotopy-colimit argument.
